topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Well, I’ll be! Imagine sowing a bit of your mind, a story you wrote thinking it just for the eyes of a few, and then one day, there it is, beyond the boundaries of your own little field, shared and spoken of. It’s like finding a good harvest left outside your barn door when you woke up, not knowing who planted it or how it grew so fine. It’s a fine surprise, a stroke of good fortune. Shows that even the quietest words have their place under the sun, and sometimes, when you least expect it, they find a way to shine. Who knew the soil of our minds could yield such far-reaching crops?
